description: This file contains build-related constants, helper functions for platform module loading, toolchain path management, and platform configuration caching, specific to the 'starboard' build system.

classes.name: ClangSpecification
classes.description: Represents a specific version of Clang with revision and version attributes.

methods.name: GetToolchainsDir
methods.description: Returns the directory containing all downloaded toolchains, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: _GetClangBasePath
methods.description: Constructs the base path for a specific Clang revision.

methods.name: GetClangBinPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the Clang binary directory for a given Clang specification.

methods.name: _ModuleLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a module is already loaded based on its name and path.

methods.name: _LoadPlatformModule
methods.description: Loads a platform-specific module (e.g., configuration or test filters) based on platform name, filename, and function name.

methods.name: _LoadPlatformConfig
methods.description: Loads and returns a platform-specific configuration object.

methods.name: _LoadPlatformTestFilters
methods.description: Loads and returns platform-specific test filters.

methods.name: GetPlatformConfig
methods.description: Returns a cached platform configuration object, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: GetPlatformTestFilters
methods.description: Returns a cached platform test filters object, loading it if necessary.
